entries.source: Banana Boat in Alanya. Classic group water ride for 4–8 guests. 10–12 minutes of speed, splashes and summer fun on the Mediterranean Sea. Minimum 4 people from €120.
entries.translation: Banana Boat in Alanya. Classic group water ride for 4–8 guests. 10–12 minutes of speed, splashes and summer fun on the Mediterranean Sea. Minimum 4 people from €120.

entries.source: The classic group water ride full of speed, laughter and summer fun

entries.source: Enjoy a classic Banana Boat ride in Alanya with friends and family. Hold tight, feel the speed, bounce over the waves and enjoy 10–12 minutes of laughter, splashes and unforgettable Mediterranean summer fun.

entries.source: The inflatable banana is pulled by a motorboat while guests sit in a line, keep both hands on the safety handles and follow the crew’s signals.
